chosenApproach: Preserve the unchanged R1 release contract, canonical recipient payload and original R1 BUKLOD Community URL as an actual fallback whenever no SOS R2 root overlay subscriber is mounted. A live mounted R2 host consumes the signal without navigation, preserving existing forms/drafts and content; if cold-start push arrives before host mounts, route to /buklod?help_request_id=UUID. The Public Community screen validates the UUID and forwards it to R2 overlay; signal emitter buffers at most four ID/origin events for two minutes to survive early subscriptions. R2 host still checks current account's canonical notification row, active nearby authorized RPC, owner isolation and expire/resolve rules. Invalid IDs go to notifications only. Add behavioral lock to production Android workflow immediately after the unchanged R1 contract.
selectionRationale: Restoring a real operational fallback and bounded in-memory handoff preserves both locked R1 Community routing and R2 global overlay UX. Merely adding the anchor as a comment or removing/loosening the R1 script would mask broken cold-start routing. Updating unrelated AdMob, native runtime, notifications fan-out or database would risk a new regression, so no such changes are made.
